title: Incremented Canonical Count
statement: For every Boolean word $w$, incrementing the word obtained by appending a zero succeeds, returns the canonical count word, and increases both its length and its little-endian binary value by one. That is, the result has length $|w|+1$ and value equal to the value of $w$ plus one.
